title: Transactional Outbox Pattern with PostgreSQL CDC & Kafka Publishing

topIssues.description: Stack components lack explicit pinned minimum semver versions
topIssues.evidenceOrSource: Language and SDK release lifecycle documentation

topIssues.quote: Application executes transaction writing to orders table and outbox_events table
